summary: Regression test after L1 modularization pass (index.tsx 6255->5029 lines; extracted appShared.tsx + NetWorthScreen.tsx). All 8 numbered scenarios PASS on Playwright web preview (viewport 390x844). Behavior unchanged: welcome + iframe bridge renders, login via testIDs succeeds, Home shows Net Worth snapshot + Budget card, Wealth tab renders PageHeader/eye toggle/sync banner (No accounts linked)/dark hero card with TOTAL NET WORTH + chart-placeholder copy ('Not enough history yet.')/wealth-period pills/Cash-SetAside-Available row/SET ASIDE CASH section. Period pills fire GET /api/networth/history?range=month|quarter|year (3 calls captured, all 200). All 5 bottom-nav tabs (home, budget, transactions, legacy, networth) tap without white-screen. Logout via home-bell -> settings-logout returns to Welcome iframe. Zero 'is not defined' / 'Cannot read propert' console errors during the whole flow. Only pre-existing warnings observed: React Native Web shadow* deprecation (whitelisted) + iframe sandbox warning.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is still 5029 lines - well above the 700-line guideline. Continue extracting screens (HomeScreen, SettingsScreen, TransactionsScreen, BudgetScreen, LegacyScreen) in subsequent modularization passes.

Welcome screen embeds an <iframe srcDoc=...> with sandbox 'allow-scripts allow-same-origin'; browsers emit a sandbox warning (not a bug, but flagged so it stays known). Cannot be selected by regular Playwright selectors -- tests must postMessage('navigate:login' | 'navigate:onboarding') to bridge into the RN screens.
NetWorthScreen prop signature is large (13+ props) -- consider a context or a memoized 'wealthProps' object to keep the render call in index.tsx line 4985 concise.
